selection_policy: Every application in every selected scope category is returned deterministically; no vector or LLM filtering is allowed.
authorities: Kansas City Board of Public Utilities
Kansas Department of Health and Environment
quality_gates: Every workflow has a registered official source
Every workflow has at least 10 executable, substantive, evidence-gated checks
Every check returns not verified when evidence is unavailable
Every permit-specific check targets the exact kck_* permit type
State and federal construction approvals remain visible until project facts resolve applicability
All detected zoning classifications receive fail-closed district checks
Every selected rule receives exactly one traceable result
notes: The UG publishes forms and department workflows rather than one enumerable self-service catalog. EstatePermit normalizes municipal, utility, Kansas state, and federal construction workflows without treating semantic retrieval or an LLM as an applicability decision. Separate municipal jurisdictions outside Kansas City, Kansas remain outside this jurisdiction pack.
